name: test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    # Release evidence is proved on the tag you actually ship from. Before
    # this, the repo had NO release-time evidence check at all: the gate ran
    # only on pushes to main, so a tag could be cut without its proof ever
    # being verified at the point it is published.
    tags: ["v*"]
  pull_request:
  # So anyone can ask "is the evidence release-ready?" without cutting a tag.
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - run: go vet ./...
      - run: |
          unformatted=$(gofmt -l -s .)
          if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then
            echo "::error::unformatted files:"
            echo "$unformatted"
            exit 1
          fi

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        goos: [darwin, linux, windows]
        goarch: [amd64, arm64]
        exclude:
          - { goos: windows, goarch: arm64 }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - env:
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goarch }}
        run: go build ./...

  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - run: go test -race -timeout 20m ./...

  windows-test-prepare:
    name: test (windows-latest) / compile and plan
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    outputs:
      shard-matrix: ${{ steps.shard-matrix.outputs.value }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.27.1"
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Validate the Windows sharding harness
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s tools/ci-bench/windows-production/tests -p "test_*.py" -v
      - name: Compile once and inventory default-runnable roots
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $repository = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.').Path
          $output = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-test-bundle'
          & python -B tools/ci-bench/windows-production/prepare.py `
            --repository $repository `
            --output $output `
            --settings tools/ci-bench/windows-production/settings.json `
            --weights tools/ci-bench/windows-production/historical-weights.json `
            --expected-repository-sha '${{ github.sha }}'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Export the authoritative shard matrix
        id: shard-matrix
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $planPath = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-test-bundle/plan.json'
          $plan = Get-Content -LiteralPath $planPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $indexes = @($plan.shards | ForEach-Object { [int] $_.index })
          if ($indexes.Count -ne [int] $plan.shardCount -or $indexes.Count -eq 0) {
            throw 'plan shard indexes do not match shardCount'
          }
          $matrix = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $indexes -Compress
          "value=$matrix" | Out-File -LiteralPath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Upload immutable Windows test bundle
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-bundle
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 3

  windows-test-shards:
    name: test (windows-latest) / shard ${{ matrix.shard }}
    needs: windows-test-prepare
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 8
      matrix:
        shard: ${{ fromJSON(needs.windows-test-prepare.outputs.shard-matrix) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.27.1"
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-bundle
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle
      - name: Execute the assigned compiled roots
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $repository = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.').Path
          $bundle = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle').Path
          $output = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-test-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}'
          & python -B tools/ci-bench/windows-production/run_shard.py `
            --repository $repository `
            --bundle $bundle `
            --output $output `
            --shard-index '${{ matrix.shard }}' `
            --expected-repository-sha '${{ github.sha }}'
          exit $LASTEXITCODE
      - name: Upload shard evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3

  windows-test-other:
    name: test (windows-latest) / non-heavy packages
    needs: windows-test-prepare
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.27.1"
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-bundle
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle
      - name: Run every target-Windows non-heavy package once
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $repository = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.').Path
          $bundle = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle').Path
          $output = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-test-other'
          & python -B tools/ci-bench/windows-production/run_other.py `
            --repository $repository `
            --bundle $bundle `
            --output $output `
            --expected-repository-sha '${{ github.sha }}'
          exit $LASTEXITCODE
      - name: Upload non-heavy package evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-other
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-other
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3

  windows-test-vet:
    name: test (windows-latest) / vet
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.27.1"
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum
      - run: go vet -race ./...

  windows-test-verify:
    name: test (windows-latest) / coverage and integrity
    needs: [windows-test-prepare, windows-test-shards, windows-test-other]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.windows-test-prepare.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-bundle
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          pattern: windows-test-shard-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-shards
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-other
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-other
      - name: Verify exact root, package, process, and artifact coverage
        run: |
          python -B tools/ci-bench/windows-production/verify_results.py \
            --bundle "${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle" \
            --shard-results "${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-shards" \
            --other-results "${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-other" \
            --output "${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-verification.json"
      - name: Upload verification report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-verification
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-verification.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3

  # Keep the former matrix check identity stable for required-check migration.
  windows-test:
    name: test (windows-latest)
    needs:
      [windows-test-prepare, windows-test-shards, windows-test-other, windows-test-vet, windows-test-verify]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require every Windows test component
        env:
          PREPARE_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-prepare.result }}
          SHARDS_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-shards.result }}
          OTHER_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-other.result }}
          VET_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-vet.result }}
          VERIFY_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-verify.result }}
        run: |
          for result in "$PREPARE_RESULT" "$SHARDS_RESULT" "$OTHER_RESULT" "$VET_RESULT" "$VERIFY_RESULT"; do
            if [ "$result" != success ]; then
              echo "A required Windows test component ended with: $result" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done

  # Stage 1b cgo stack: mattn/go-sqlite3 + sqlite-vec (vec0) + FTS5. The
  # default jobs above stay pure-Go and prove the cgo-less fallback; this lane
  # proves the cgo stack on the platforms with a stock C toolchain. Windows
  # cgo (mingw) is a deferred follow-up — Windows users get the pure-Go build.
  test-cgo:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      CGO_ENABLED: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - run: go test -race -tags "brain_cgo sqlite_fts5" -timeout 20m ./...

  phase1-semantic:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      ENTIRE_BRAIN_PHASE1_CI: "1"
      GOPROXY: "off"
      GOSUMDB: "off"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - name: Prime module cache
        env:
          GOPROXY: "https://proxy.golang.org,direct"
          GOSUMDB: "sum.golang.org"
        run: go mod download
      - name: Run deterministic Phase 1 semantic tests
        run: go test -race -timeout 20m ./internal/cli -run 'TestPhase1|TestSemantic|TestWorkspace|TestMCP|TestRefreshSemantic'

  # The benchmark harness is Python and `go test ./...` does not see it. This job
  # is its only gate, so it must run the whole suite by DISCOVERY, not by a list:
  # the previous hand-maintained list named five scripts, two of them narrowed to
  # one TestCase class, and executed ten tests in ten seconds. Everything else —
  # 36 of 39 test modules and 310 of run_test.py's 313 tests — ran nowhere, so a
  # fix whose evidence was a new test file was reported green without that
  # evidence ever being executed. ci_tests.py discovers every test module, and
  # carries the quarantine list for the modules that are red on a clean checkout.
  benchmark-corpus:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # fetch-depth 0: the packet-format A/B modules assert that a recorded
      # product-contract commit is an ancestor of HEAD, which a depth-1 checkout
      # cannot answer.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      # The suite was written against Python 3.14 (it packages evidence with
      # tarfile's zstd mode, added there). The job previously used whatever
      # `python3` the image happened to ship — 3.12 — and never declared an
      # interpreter, because the modules that need one were not being run.
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6.0.0
        with: { python-version: "3.14" }
      # The task negative-control module drives the pinned Go toolchain. Same
      # story: the job had no Go at all.
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.26.2" }
      # That module discovers its toolchain with GOPROXY=off, deliberately — the
      # receipt it produces is only a negative control if the runtime is fixed
      # and local. So the pin it names has to be in the module cache before it
      # runs; this is the one command allowed to fetch it.
      - name: Prime the Go toolchain the task negative control pins
        run: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.4 go version
      - name: Validate mined-scale corpus and run the benchmark test suite
        run: |
          set -e
          python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/mined-scale/check_manifest.py
          python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/ci_tests.py

  release-evidence:
    # Release-evidence audits enforce proof-ready release artifacts: they prove
    # a retained performance or tool claim was measured against the code being
    # shipped. That question is asked AT RELEASE, which is where this now runs
    # — on a v* tag, or on demand via workflow_dispatch.
    #
    # It used to run on every push to main, and that was the wrong trigger. The
    # manifests pin six source files by content hash, including test files, so
    # ANY edit to them marks the measurement stale — the run that made main red
    # on 2026-09-11 was tripped by `style(distill): group fact merge imports
    # consistently`, an import-grouping change that cannot affect a scheduler
    # benchmark. The evidence has been re-recorded eight times since June for
    # this reason, and went stale again six days after the last re-record
    # (#194). A gate that red-lights main for reasons unrelated to the commit
    # being pushed does not enforce anything; it teaches everyone to ignore CI,
    # and the one failure that matters goes with it.
    #
    # NOTHING IS WEAKENED. The audits still run with --fail-on-flags and still
    # refuse a stale report; a tag carrying stale evidence fails exactly as it
    # would have. What changed is that ordinary development on main no longer
    # trips a release-time proof, and a release can no longer be cut without
    # that proof being checked.
    #
    # Re-record before tagging: regenerate the retained artifacts on a
    # representative machine (the timings are hardware-specific), then commit
    # the manifest and both report files together.
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - name: Check retained release evidence
        run: |
          # Every lane is checked before the job decides. `set -e` used to stop at
          # the first failing audit, so a red main reported one stale lane while
          # hiding the rest: on 2026-08-19 two lanes went stale in the same merge,
          # only the Radar tool lane was ever named, and the change that refreshed
          # it would have left main red on the distill lane nobody had seen.
          set -uo pipefail
          tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
          trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
          failures=0
          check() {
            label="$1"
            shift
            if ! "$@"; then
              echo "::error::release-evidence check failed: $label"
              failures=$((failures + 1))
            fi
          }
          compare() {
            label="$1"
            committed="$2"
            generated="$3"
            if ! cmp -s "$committed" "$generated"; then
              echo "::error::retained $label report is stale: $(basename "$committed")"
              diff -u "$committed" "$generated" >&2 || true
              failures=$((failures + 1))
            fi
          }
          check "benchmark harness tests" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/run_test.py
          check "replay-lab release evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_codex.py \
            --results benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release \
            --release-manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "clean replay-lab proof" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_codex.py \
            --results benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/replay-lab-clean \
            --release-manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/replay-lab-clean/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp/clean-proof" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "Radar agent-lift evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_radar_evidence.py \
            --results benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release \
            --suite-glob 'release-candidate-*' \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --codex-audit-report "$tmp/codex-audit-report.json" \
            --fail-when-no-proof
          check "Radar tool-contract evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_radar_tool_evidence.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/radar-tool/manifest.json \
            --repo-root . \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "workspace Radar evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_workspace_radar_evidence.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/workspace-radar/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "current-repo distill performance evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_distill_perf.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/distill-perf/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "large-repo distill performance evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_distill_perf.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/distill-perf-large/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp/distill-large" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "facts eval evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_facts_eval.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/facts-eval/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "release matrix" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_release_matrix.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release-matrix/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          for report in codex-audit-report.json codex-audit-report.md; do
            compare "release evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in codex-audit-report.json codex-audit-report.md; do
            compare "clean replay-lab proof" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/replay-lab-clean/$report" "$tmp/clean-proof/$report"
          done
          for report in radar-tool-audit-report.json radar-tool-audit-report.md; do
            compare "Radar tool evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/radar-tool/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in workspace-radar-audit-report.json workspace-radar-audit-report.md; do
            compare "workspace Radar evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/workspace-radar/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in distill-perf-audit-report.json distill-perf-audit-report.md; do
            compare "distill performance evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/distill-perf/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in distill-perf-audit-report.json distill-perf-audit-report.md; do
            compare "large-repo distill performance evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/distill-perf-large/$report" "$tmp/distill-large/$report"
          done
          for report in facts-eval-audit-report.json facts-eval-audit-report.md; do
            compare "facts eval evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/facts-eval/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in release-matrix-report.json release-matrix-report.md; do
            compare "release matrix" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release-matrix/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          if [ "$failures" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::$failures release-evidence check(s) failed"
            exit 1
          fi

name: test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    # Release evidence is proved on the tag you actually ship from. Before
    # this, the repo had NO release-time evidence check at all: the gate ran
    # only on pushes to main, so a tag could be cut without its proof ever
    # being verified at the point it is published.
    tags: ["v*"]
  pull_request:
  # So anyone can ask "is the evidence release-ready?" without cutting a tag.
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - run: go vet ./...
      - run: |
          unformatted=$(gofmt -l -s .)
          if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then
            echo "::error::unformatted files:"
            echo "$unformatted"
            exit 1
          fi

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        goos: [darwin, linux, windows]
        goarch: [amd64, arm64]
        exclude:
          - { goos: windows, goarch: arm64 }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - env:
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goarch }}
        run: go build ./...

  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - run: go test -race -timeout 20m ./...

  windows-test-prepare:
    name: test (windows-latest) / compile and plan
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    outputs:
      shard-matrix: ${{ steps.shard-matrix.outputs.value }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.27.1"
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Validate the Windows sharding harness
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s tools/ci-bench/windows-production/tests -p "test_*.py" -v
      - name: Compile once and inventory default-runnable roots
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $repository = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.').Path
          $output = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-test-bundle'
          & python -B tools/ci-bench/windows-production/prepare.py `
            --repository $repository `
            --output $output `
            --settings tools/ci-bench/windows-production/settings.json `
            --weights tools/ci-bench/windows-production/historical-weights.json `
            --expected-repository-sha '${{ github.sha }}'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Export the authoritative shard matrix
        id: shard-matrix
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $planPath = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-test-bundle/plan.json'
          $plan = Get-Content -LiteralPath $planPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $indexes = @($plan.shards | ForEach-Object { [int] $_.index })
          if ($indexes.Count -ne [int] $plan.shardCount -or $indexes.Count -eq 0) {
            throw 'plan shard indexes do not match shardCount'
          }
          $matrix = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $indexes -Compress
          "value=$matrix" | Out-File -LiteralPath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Upload immutable Windows test bundle
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-bundle
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 3

  windows-test-shards:
    name: test (windows-latest) / shard ${{ matrix.shard }}
    needs: windows-test-prepare
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 8
      matrix:
        shard: ${{ fromJSON(needs.windows-test-prepare.outputs.shard-matrix) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.27.1"
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-bundle
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle
      - name: Execute the assigned compiled roots
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $repository = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.').Path
          $bundle = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle').Path
          $output = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-test-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}'
          & python -B tools/ci-bench/windows-production/run_shard.py `
            --repository $repository `
            --bundle $bundle `
            --output $output `
            --shard-index '${{ matrix.shard }}' `
            --expected-repository-sha '${{ github.sha }}'
          exit $LASTEXITCODE
      - name: Upload shard evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3

  windows-test-other:
    name: test (windows-latest) / non-heavy packages
    needs: windows-test-prepare
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.27.1"
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-bundle
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle
      - name: Run every target-Windows non-heavy package once
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $repository = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.').Path
          $bundle = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle').Path
          $output = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-test-other'
          & python -B tools/ci-bench/windows-production/run_other.py `
            --repository $repository `
            --bundle $bundle `
            --output $output `
            --expected-repository-sha '${{ github.sha }}'
          exit $LASTEXITCODE
      - name: Upload non-heavy package evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-other
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-other
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3

  windows-test-vet:
    name: test (windows-latest) / vet
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.27.1"
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum
      - run: go vet -race ./...

  windows-test-verify:
    name: test (windows-latest) / coverage and integrity
    needs: [windows-test-prepare, windows-test-shards, windows-test-other]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.windows-test-prepare.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-bundle
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          pattern: windows-test-shard-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-shards
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-other
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-other
      - name: Verify exact root, package, process, and artifact coverage
        run: |
          python -B tools/ci-bench/windows-production/verify_results.py \
            --bundle "${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-bundle" \
            --shard-results "${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-shards" \
            --other-results "${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-other" \
            --output "${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-verification.json"
      - name: Upload verification report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: windows-test-verification
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-test-verification.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3

  # Keep the former matrix check identity stable for required-check migration.
  windows-test:
    name: test (windows-latest)
    needs:
      [windows-test-prepare, windows-test-shards, windows-test-other, windows-test-vet, windows-test-verify]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require every Windows test component
        env:
          PREPARE_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-prepare.result }}
          SHARDS_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-shards.result }}
          OTHER_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-other.result }}
          VET_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-vet.result }}
          VERIFY_RESULT: ${{ needs.windows-test-verify.result }}
        run: |
          for result in "$PREPARE_RESULT" "$SHARDS_RESULT" "$OTHER_RESULT" "$VET_RESULT" "$VERIFY_RESULT"; do
            if [ "$result" != success ]; then
              echo "A required Windows test component ended with: $result" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done

  # Stage 1b cgo stack: mattn/go-sqlite3 + sqlite-vec (vec0) + FTS5. The
  # default jobs above stay pure-Go and prove the cgo-less fallback; this lane
  # proves the cgo stack on the platforms with a stock C toolchain. Windows
  # cgo (mingw) is a deferred follow-up — Windows users get the pure-Go build.
  test-cgo:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      CGO_ENABLED: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - run: go test -race -tags "brain_cgo sqlite_fts5" -timeout 20m ./...

  phase1-semantic:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      ENTIRE_BRAIN_PHASE1_CI: "1"
      GOPROXY: "off"
      GOSUMDB: "off"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.27.1" }
      - name: Prime module cache
        env:
          GOPROXY: "https://proxy.golang.org,direct"
          GOSUMDB: "sum.golang.org"
        run: go mod download
      - name: Run deterministic Phase 1 semantic tests
        run: go test -race -timeout 20m ./internal/cli -run 'TestPhase1|TestSemantic|TestWorkspace|TestMCP|TestRefreshSemantic'

  # The benchmark harness is Python and `go test ./...` does not see it. This job
  # is its only gate, so it must run the whole suite by DISCOVERY, not by a list:
  # the previous hand-maintained list named five scripts, two of them narrowed to
  # one TestCase class, and executed ten tests in ten seconds. Everything else —
  # 36 of 39 test modules and 310 of run_test.py's 313 tests — ran nowhere, so a
  # fix whose evidence was a new test file was reported green without that
  # evidence ever being executed. ci_tests.py discovers every test module, and
  # carries the quarantine list for the modules that are red on a clean checkout.
  benchmark-corpus:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # fetch-depth 0: the packet-format A/B modules assert that a recorded
      # product-contract commit is an ancestor of HEAD, which a depth-1 checkout
      # cannot answer.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      # The suite was written against Python 3.14 (it packages evidence with
      # tarfile's zstd mode, added there). The job previously used whatever
      # `python3` the image happened to ship — 3.12 — and never declared an
      # interpreter, because the modules that need one were not being run.
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6.0.0
        with: { python-version: "3.14" }
      # The task negative-control module drives the pinned Go toolchain. Same
      # story: the job had no Go at all.
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6.4.0
        with: { go-version: "1.26.2" }
      # That module discovers its toolchain with GOPROXY=off, deliberately — the
      # receipt it produces is only a negative control if the runtime is fixed
      # and local. So the pin it names has to be in the module cache before it
      # runs; this is the one command allowed to fetch it.
      - name: Prime the Go toolchain the task negative control pins
        run: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.4 go version
      - name: Validate mined-scale corpus and run the benchmark test suite
        run: |
          set -e
          python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/mined-scale/check_manifest.py
          python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/ci_tests.py

  release-evidence:
    # Release-evidence audits enforce proof-ready release artifacts: they prove
    # a retained performance or tool claim was measured against the code being
    # shipped. That question is asked AT RELEASE, which is where this now runs
    # — on a v* tag, or on demand via workflow_dispatch.
    #
    # It used to run on every push to main, and that was the wrong trigger. The
    # manifests pin six source files by content hash, including test files, so
    # ANY edit to them marks the measurement stale — the run that made main red
    # on 2026-09-11 was tripped by `style(distill): group fact merge imports
    # consistently`, an import-grouping change that cannot affect a scheduler
    # benchmark. The evidence has been re-recorded eight times since June for
    # this reason, and went stale again six days after the last re-record
    # (#194). A gate that red-lights main for reasons unrelated to the commit
    # being pushed does not enforce anything; it teaches everyone to ignore CI,
    # and the one failure that matters goes with it.
    #
    # NOTHING IS WEAKENED. The audits still run with --fail-on-flags and still
    # refuse a stale report; a tag carrying stale evidence fails exactly as it
    # would have. What changed is that ordinary development on main no longer
    # trips a release-time proof, and a release can no longer be cut without
    # that proof being checked.
    #
    # Re-record before tagging: regenerate the retained artifacts on a
    # representative machine (the timings are hardware-specific), then commit
    # the manifest and both report files together.
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - name: Check retained release evidence
        run: |
          # Every lane is checked before the job decides. `set -e` used to stop at
          # the first failing audit, so a red main reported one stale lane while
          # hiding the rest: on 2026-08-19 two lanes went stale in the same merge,
          # only the Radar tool lane was ever named, and the change that refreshed
          # it would have left main red on the distill lane nobody had seen.
          set -uo pipefail
          tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
          trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
          failures=0
          check() {
            label="$1"
            shift
            if ! "$@"; then
              echo "::error::release-evidence check failed: $label"
              failures=$((failures + 1))
            fi
          }
          compare() {
            label="$1"
            committed="$2"
            generated="$3"
            if ! cmp -s "$committed" "$generated"; then
              echo "::error::retained $label report is stale: $(basename "$committed")"
              diff -u "$committed" "$generated" >&2 || true
              failures=$((failures + 1))
            fi
          }
          check "benchmark harness tests" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/run_test.py
          check "replay-lab release evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_codex.py \
            --results benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release \
            --release-manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "clean replay-lab proof" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_codex.py \
            --results benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/replay-lab-clean \
            --release-manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/replay-lab-clean/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp/clean-proof" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "Radar agent-lift evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_radar_evidence.py \
            --results benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release \
            --suite-glob 'release-candidate-*' \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --codex-audit-report "$tmp/codex-audit-report.json" \
            --fail-when-no-proof
          check "Radar tool-contract evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_radar_tool_evidence.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/radar-tool/manifest.json \
            --repo-root . \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "workspace Radar evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_workspace_radar_evidence.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/workspace-radar/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "current-repo distill performance evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_distill_perf.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/distill-perf/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "large-repo distill performance evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_distill_perf.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/distill-perf-large/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp/distill-large" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "facts eval evidence" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_facts_eval.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/facts-eval/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          check "release matrix" \
            python3 benchmarks/agent-brain/audit_release_matrix.py \
            --manifest benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release-matrix/manifest.json \
            --out-dir "$tmp" \
            --fail-on-flags
          for report in codex-audit-report.json codex-audit-report.md; do
            compare "release evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in codex-audit-report.json codex-audit-report.md; do
            compare "clean replay-lab proof" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/replay-lab-clean/$report" "$tmp/clean-proof/$report"
          done
          for report in radar-tool-audit-report.json radar-tool-audit-report.md; do
            compare "Radar tool evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/radar-tool/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in workspace-radar-audit-report.json workspace-radar-audit-report.md; do
            compare "workspace Radar evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/workspace-radar/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in distill-perf-audit-report.json distill-perf-audit-report.md; do
            compare "distill performance evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/distill-perf/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in distill-perf-audit-report.json distill-perf-audit-report.md; do
            compare "large-repo distill performance evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/distill-perf-large/$report" "$tmp/distill-large/$report"
          done
          for report in facts-eval-audit-report.json facts-eval-audit-report.md; do
            compare "facts eval evidence" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/facts-eval/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          for report in release-matrix-report.json release-matrix-report.md; do
            compare "release matrix" \
              "benchmarks/agent-brain/evidence/release-matrix/$report" "$tmp/$report"
          done
          if [ "$failures" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::$failures release-evidence check(s) failed"
            exit 1
          fi

# Coordinated agent instructions

Both products provide `init-agents` and `agent-guide`, invoked through
`entire graph` and `entire brain`. Brain also retains `guide` as an alias.

## Generation-time routing

| Invoked command | Check | Generated workflow |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Graph initializer or preview | Brain appears in `entire plugin list` and this repository has a Brain | Graph and Brain |
| Graph initializer or preview | Otherwise | Graph only |
| Brain initializer or preview | Graph appears in `entire plugin list` | Graph and Brain |
| Brain initializer or preview | Otherwise | Brain only |

`entire plugin list` enumerates managed installations without dispatching plugins.
Its current CLI offers text output, not JSON; an unexpected listing or command
failure is reported explicitly. Unmanaged executables that do not appear in that
list do not activate the peer. No plugin executable is invoked for detection.

Graph determines repository Brain state using safe, bounded local reads. A valid
`setup.json` written by Brain setup under `<state>/repos/<key>/` establishes setup.
When that record is absent, a valid `<data>/repos/<key>/manifest.json` recognizes
Brains created through older build/refresh paths. Missing or stale indexes do not
change the mode; a setup record is sufficient without reading an index manifest.
Malformed, unreadable, oversized, nonregular, or unsupported setup records cause
an error rather than masquerading as absence. Generated guides never count as
setup records.

Repository identity uses the same read-only `git remote get-url origin` lookup as
Brain, its existing known host mappings, learned custom mappings in `<config>/brain.json`, or the canonical
local-path hash (also checking Brain's legacy root spellings). Generation never
creates a custom host mapping. It does not contact Git remotes or run hooks.
Git includes and URL rewrites are honored so generation finds the same repository identity as Brain. Ambiguous
canonical/legacy setup records are rejected.

Default Brain directories match Brain's standalone layout: XDG state/config roots
under `entire`, and `XDG_DATA_HOME/entire/plugins/data/brain`, with the normal home
fallbacks. For a Brain configured under custom plugin directories, set the explicit
coordination overrides `ENTIRE_BRAIN_STATE_DIR`, `ENTIRE_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR`, and
`ENTIRE_BRAIN_DATA_DIR` consistently for generation. These are new, read-only lookup
overrides; they do not change where Brain setup writes. Graph's plugin data/cache
directory is never mistaken for Brain's data directory.

## One installed guide

Either initializer writes `.entire/agent-guide.md`, the only workflow body.
Both use the same standard-library-only `internal/agentsetup` package, mirrored in
the two source repositories. There is no dependency on the peer binary and no
recursive initialization.

A single `entire-agent:begin` / `entire-agent:end` managed block references the guide
from each independent `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` instruction file. When Claude already
imports AGENTS, its block records inheritance instead of adding another guide
import. Existing instruction-file aliases remain supported. Text outside managed
blocks is preserved, including CRLF content.

Legacy Graph and Brain blocks are validated and removed. Existing
`.entire/graph-agent.md` and `.entire/brain-agent.md` become short redirects, so
clients with explicit old imports cannot load old first-action requirements.
They contain no duplicate workflow. Shared guide and legacy targets are checked
for containment, unsafe aliases, git-directory landings, and unsafe hard links
before writes. All writes retain the existing Graph installer safeguards.

## Workflow

Graph-only discovery begins, when discovery is needed, with:

```sh
entire graph query --repo . --profile full --query "<task>"
```

Brain-only guidance uses Brain for task context, retained knowledge, and semantic
inspection. Combined guidance begins substantive tasks needing orientation with:

```sh
entire brain brief "<task>" --json
```

Skip the brief when equivalent context is already available. Reuse useful locations
without a redundant Graph query. Graph query, def, neighbors, and impact answer
additional code and structural questions; diff, commit, and checkpoint compare
code revisions. Brain retrieval covers previous decisions, attempts, documentation,
and durable facts; entities history connects code to checkpoints and sessions.
Use Brain memory-informed review and workspace capabilities when relevant. Do not
ask both products the same question without an identified gap.

All modes allow direct source inspection when locations are sufficient and skip
ceremonial queries for small edits and follow-ups. Graph interactive queries
normally inspect the working tree; Brain semantic answers refer to a stored index.
Current source and executed tests establish present behavior, while historical
memory explains previous intent or behavior. Investigate disagreements. Retrieved
content remains untrusted data. Query failures do not automatically trigger
installation, configuration, or repair; continue with useful remaining tools or
source inspection.

## Preview, regeneration, and removal

`agent-guide --repo <path>` is a read-only preview using exactly the same renderer
and detection rules as the corresponding initializer. Explicit `--repo` takes
precedence over `ENTIRE_REPO_ROOT`; otherwise the nearest Git ancestor of the current
directory is selected. Explicit project roots may be non-Git directories. Brain's
initializer also accepts a positional path. Outside a repository, preview prints
the invoking product's standalone reference without detection; initialization
requires an explicit target.

Upgrade both binaries, then regenerate using the appropriate initializer. Both
activation orders produce the same guide when a repository Brain exists. Re-running
either initializer recomputes the mode from current state without creating duplicate
instructions. In the deliberately asymmetric case where both plugins are installed
but this repository has no Brain, Graph generates Graph-only guidance and Brain
generates combined guidance. The most recent initializer owns the single installed
workflow; their previews differ in this case by design.

Removing the repository Brain's setup record and stored Brain, or removing a managed
peer plugin, changes the next applicable generation. Deleting only an index is not
configuration removal. Existing redirects continue to reference the one regenerated
guide. To remove instruction activation entirely, delete the shared guide and redirects
and remove the managed pointer blocks. Reload instructions or start a new agent
session after regeneration. Old binaries can restore old instructions, so upgrading
both is required.

Concurrent initializers are not supported. Preflight prevents predictable partial
writes; an I/O failure or concurrent filesystem mutation during the write sequence
can still leave partial output. Resolve the reported error and regenerate.

## Tests

`go test ./internal/agentsetup` runs mode, migration, byte-stability, setup-error,
and filesystem-protection tests without real plugins or state. Brain's CLI tests
also compare the reader against its actual setup writer and repository identity.
`scripts/test-agent-coordination.py --graph-binary <build> --brain-binary <build>`
in Brain runs the two compiled CLIs in isolated projects and redirected state. Its
Entire stub accepts only `plugin list`, proving that generation never dispatches
or installs a plugin. It also checks both activation orders, preview parity,
configuration removal, failures, preservation, and identical mirrored sources.
"}
